name: Camp Fernwood
description_short: An overnight summer camp for girls in Maine, running since 1921. It runs one full session of about seven weeks.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Maine Girls Summer Camp | Camp Fernwood | Dates and Pricing

warnings: The page never says outright that campers stay overnight. It is listed as sleepaway because it is a 7-week Maine camp with a Visiting Day and one-way email to campers. Confirm with the camp.
Horseback riding and private tennis lessons cost extra and are not in the $17,300 tuition. Those prices are not given.
The page says the camp is for girls, but no age or grade range is given.
unknowns: Whether a deposit is required, and the deposit amount
Whether shorter sessions are offered besides the full 7-week session
Prices for optional horseback riding and private tennis lessons
Whether places are still open for 2027
Whether the camp is ACA accredited
